assessment: The authors have explored potential crosstalk between endothelial cells and fibroblasts in the context of sporadic vascular malformation (venous malformation and angiomatoses of soft tissue). With a high level of evidence, they found that mutated endothelial cells secrete TGFa that will activate surrounding fibroblasts, leading in turn to VEGFA secretion that will stimulate endothelial cells sprouting and vascular malformation development. This is an important advance in the field.
